verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs' llms.txt states it offers official Python and Node.js SDKs alongside HTTP and WebSocket support, so developers can build against first-party SDKs. The detailed speech-to-text API reference (convert endpoint, realtime WebSockets) supports this, but the SDK claim itself rests on a single line. missing for 10: SDK-specific documentation or code examples for Scribe transcription, coverage of SDK languages beyond Python/Node.js, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
